text:
incident_bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 500s from metadata-store (postgres) connections in us-east-1. Auto-alert fired for error-rate > 2% on /embeddings and /uploads. Paging oncall.
leo_oncall: seeing spike in connection_count and lots of WAIT events on the DB side. Grafana panel: `pg_stat_activity` shows many idle-in-transaction sessions.
maya_sre: looking at app logs -> batch worker appears to be retrying failed writes aggressively after a transient storage latency event. Example log:
```
[2026-03-12T09:34:12Z] batch-writer v3: write failed: timeout after 10s, retrying (attempt=7)
[2026-03-12T09:34:13Z] batch-writer v3: opened tx but not closed -> idle_tx=1
```
tia_backend: killing runaway batch-writer job group on us-east-1 (job-pool-12). Scaling down concurrency from 40 -> 8. Pushing hotfix to ensure transactions close on retry.
product_ops: updating status page: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/1769459999 — Impact: increased error rates and slow responses for embeddings and uploads in us-east-1. Mitigation underway.
infra_lead: temporarily increased DB connection limit on read-replica to absorb inflight sessions. Monitoring.
customer_success: fielding a couple of tickets from customers using large batch uploads; sharing status page link and ETA to stability.
leo_oncall: after scaling down the job pool, connection count dropped ~70% in 60s. error-rate trending down.
maya_sre: patched batch-writer to close tx on all retry paths and added guard to cap retry backoff. Hotfix deployed to job-pool-12 and job-pool-13.
product_ops: status page note updated: "Partial mitigation: job concurrency reduced and hotfix deployed; error rates declining. Monitoring for 30m."
infra_lead: DB knobs reverted to previous values now that connections are stable. Recommending longer-term fix: circuit-breaker around batch-writer retries and a connection-pool watchdog.
leo_oncall: assigning postmortem owner: maya_sre. Action items: 1) add alert for idle_in_transaction > 5 for >1min, 2) enforce retry limits in batch-writer, 3) run chaos test for burst write patterns.
customer_success: sent interim customer advisory and offered assistance to impacted customers. No major data loss reported.
incident_bot: RESOLVED signal at 1769461800 — error-rate returned to baseline and services healthy. Postmortem request created: https://redwood.internal/pm/1769459999-postmortem
